name: open-line
scope: Open Line refines the Returning Bell chapter in its existing footprint. A new central stair, shared enemy firing lane and arrow-operated brass screen release create a shorter exposed approach beside the retained gallery and ambulatory routes. A learned bell shot is a valid alternative to visiting the tower. No additional rooms, defenders or pickups.
saveCompatibility: Existing profile/envelope keys, rewards and quick-arrow controls remain. hollow-dominions-1 and returning-bell-1 restore unchanged. New expeditions use returning-bell-2; the saved layout and mechanism geometry are rebuilt before position validation. AR inspects the suspended layout, never substitutes another one.
hardwareStatus: Development slice. Software checks use actual WebGL with emulated Xbox and WebXR devices. Physical Quest 3/Xbox, comfort, sustained performance, finished art and unfamiliar-player/replay acceptance remain open.
